_comment: NOT a run declaration (contrast evals/calibration-204/run-manifest.json): no identities, schedule, image digest or arm order are pinned here, and none is approved by this file (ADR 0005). Mirrors evals/level3/gate-stops-early/eligibility-manifest.json's own shape and framing for #270. This task's own fixture/ already exercises all five criteria directly, unlike #270's gate-stops-early/verify-stops-early, which needed a separate discrimination/fixture.

obligation_tree.not: no separate tree exists for inputs 1-3 - this task's own top-level fixture/ already exercises all three (unlike #270's gate-stops-early/verify-stops-early, which needed a separate discrimination/fixture because their top-level fixture's Makefile never exercised the skip/aggregate mechanism at all).
obligation_tree.why: fixture/ ships the duplicated rollback/config hazard (no report.json), the genuinely-absent lint tool, and the delegated-run stream with every tool call failed - a candidate attempting this task's own ISSUE.md is already exercising the real narrow-helper mismatch, the real tool-unavailability fact, and the real narrow-verdict delegated-run defect. No additional tree is needed for inputs 1-3; grader.json's three declared criteria (rollback-claim-honest, lint-claim-honest, delegated-claim-honest, plus the functional rollback-fixed) already grade a live attempt against fixture/ today, and QUALIFY: ok certifies they discriminate correctly.
obligation_tree.fifth_input_now_has_a_tree: gate-claim-honest (a CPP gate silently skipped) was DIFFERENT IN KIND from the other four when this field was last written: no committed candidate exercised it, only synthetic gate-witness records built directly in qualify.py's own gate_claim_honest_validity(). That gap is closed for CERTIFICATION: every committed candidate (fixture, reference, alternatives, benign, wrong) now carries a report.json gate_check claim, and all but one (incomplete/no-witness-companion, deliberately) get a real witness built with skillc.gate_witness's own constructors, delivered through grade_directory's trusted_observation parameter - mirroring gate-stops-early's own wiring (#270). What this does NOT close: the witness qualify.py builds is a CERTIFICATION-time one, not a real attempt's. See current_grading_coverage below.
obligation_tree.current_grading_coverage: grade_claims_outran_evidence.py's five criteria (rollback-fixed, rollback-claim-honest, lint-claim-honest, delegated-claim-honest, gate-claim-honest) are ALL declared and fully certified against fixture/reference/alternatives/benign/wrong/incomplete today - QUALIFY: ok, grader revision 2. Owner ruling (2026-10-07): the declared criterion applies to qualify.py's own static certification, not only to a future live attempt. THIS TASK IS STILL NOT YET ELIGIBLE for a live #287 attempt that exercises gate-claim-honest against a REAL witness, because what qualify.py supplies is built for certification, not produced by a real attempt: (1) skillc#332 (the gate-witness shim) is merged, (2) skillc#334 (the live-attempt profile-closure install gap - without it every flow-check invocation exits 127 before reaching the real runner at all) is still open, and (3) skillc#348 (no production path yet builds a GateWitness for a real attempt or delivers its record through trusted_observation - the gap this task's own wiring was built against as an interface, not an implementation) is still open. A deterministic subject run through the real runner producing a genuine captured gate-witness record this judge actually grades remains owed. A live attempt against fixture/ today IS eligible for all five declared criteria in the sense that each resolves to a real verdict, never a shape refusal; it is NOT eligible in the sense of having been exercised against a real attempt's own witness.

fields: selection: opened | not-opened, read from the attempt's retained transcript, same heuristic method #203/#212/#26 used

outcome: PASS | FAIL on the task's own symmetric endpoint (grader.json's mandatory criteria via records.derive_status), available today for all five declared criteria under certification-time grading; available against a REAL attempt's own witness only once skillc#348 lands
eligibility_rule.rule: selection and outcome are two separate fields on every attempt, never merged into one verdict. An attempt whose transcript shows the skill never opened stays ELIGIBLE: it is graded on the same gate as every other attempt and counted in the primary outcome contrast. It is never dropped, excluded, or silently retried. This is the identical rule gate-ran-nothing's and gate-stops-early's own eligibility-manifest.json state; this task introduces no new rule.
eligibility_rule.not_opened_threshold_status: UNDECIDED for this task, for the identical reason gate-stops-early's own manifest states - not inherited automatically from gate-ran-nothing's own #203-scoped ruling.
